title: Wealthfront (WLTH) Draws Scrutiny Over Post IPO Disclosures
ai_summary: Law firm Johnson Fistel is investigating Wealthfront's post-IPO disclosures, focusing on asset flows, interest rate sensitivity, operating performance, and home lending activity. The probe examines possible breaches of federal securities laws, which could affect the firm's referral-driven growth narrative. A clean outcome would reduce overhang, while findings could undermine client trust.
